## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case / Motivation

## Proposed Implementation (Optional)
Which files or services (`AlexaAPIClient`, `AppleMusicManager`, `PlaybackCoordinator`, etc.) would this touch?
